actualResult.summary: Viewed all four supplied actual PNGs, including the native 96px portrait and the sheets' native 1x and nearest 3x panels. The large purple humanoid, pale thorn crown, teal belt and gray-brown hooked feet remain recognizable throughout. Broad upper-left highlights and right-side shadows give the torso and curved rear arm volume; the pale crown separates particularly well on dark backgrounds. Standing feet visibly share the ground line, and the prone dead pose is readable. No obvious detached limb or accidental hole through the torso is visible; the arm/body negative spaces are intentional-looking, though the front wrist/hip gap is poorly articulated. The main weaknesses are the front hand merging with the thigh, an insufficiently articulated two-hand windup, short blunt attack fingers, and compressed sleep anatomy. Skill preparation, branching contact and fragment recovery form a related sequence; the two thorn branches visibly originate at the extended hand, and the recovery retains a connected short remnant. Poison uses an abdominal hunch, stun uses hanging arms and stars, and sleep uses closed eyes and a low squat; these are distinct body states rather than simple tints or substituted attacks. Pair-to-pair changes are subtle. This is a static pose review, not battle footage: playback continuity, the 240ms idle cadence, hopping motion, combat contact and literal pxgrid authorship cannot be verified here. The portrait has 16 opaque colors and binary alpha; that observation does not establish palette compliance for every other frame. Rework is an advisory visual recommendation, not a user selection or approval.

issues.message: Around x50-63, y64-76, the forward wrist, hooked fingers and thigh contour collapse into one jagged purple shape beside a narrow zigzag transparent gap. Redraw the wrist into a continuous palm, give the thumb/fingers a clear hooked silhouette, and separate the hand from the thigh with a deliberate dark contour. Preserve an anatomically justified arm/hip gap rather than filling all negative space. Carry the clarification through idle_b and idle_c.

The crouch lowers the body, but the forward hand still overlaps the front thigh/knee while the rear hand stays close to its idle placement. Around x49-65, y70-82, draw a distinct low palm and hooked fingertips outside the knee contour; also shift the rear hand into a visibly deliberate preparation position. Both lowered hands should read independently at 1x before the stepping attack.

The extended arm is connected, but its terminal claw reads as a broad rounded mitten with short horizontal projections. Around x74-87, y52-63, taper the finger clusters into clearly down-curving hooks and retain dark gaps between them, with each finger visibly rooted in the palm. This will make the contracted long-finger hook slash clearer at native size.

Around x48-71, y78-89, the forward forearm/hand ends in a triangular projection and the pelvis becomes a dark flattened band above the two feet. Articulate a relaxed hand resting on a bent knee, then separate the knee from the belly with a short contour and a coherent light/shadow plane. Preserve the closed eyes and low resting silhouette, and apply the same anatomical clarification to sleep_b.
